f1_caveat_summary.title: Catalog hash mismatch is WARNING-only by default
f1_caveat_summary.detail: validate_catalog_hash() in default mode returns CatalogHashResult but does not halt planning. plan_scenarios() at line 110 discards return value. runner.py at line 529 calls without strict=True. A run with mismatched catalog produces examples from wrong catalog version without gate failure.

steps: runner.py: keep non-strict call at line 529 to get result and write evidence
runner.py: after writing evidence, check result.match is False and raise CatalogHashMismatchError
runner.py: add scenario_planning to HARD_STOP_STAGES so the raised error halts pipeline
planner.py line 110: pass strict=True (belt-and-suspenders, also blocks direct planner callers)
Add tests: runner raises on mismatch, runner writes evidence before raising, planner strict in generation path
fix_strategy.backward_compatible: discovery/diagnostics callers that use validate_catalog_hash directly can still pass strict=False
